recorded.prompt:q-pof: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-pof: The asset in the plan is working today, so next year's PoF is conditional: 1 - R(a+1)/R(a).
recorded.prompt:q-sweep: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-sweep: A sweep finds at most one plan per floor: 21 floors found 20 of GridCap small's 65 Pareto plans. Plain ε-constraint can also return a weakly efficient plan
recorded.prompt:q-escalation: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-escalation: Counted from the start, a project that starts later escalates less, so delay looks cheaper than it is.
